subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is a photograph of the real village road — take it only as the set reference for this shot: its flat packed earth road with cart ruts, mud-brick wall, stone milestone, lime-washed houses with grey tiled roofs, old locust tree and the low dry daylight.

An empty village road in the low morning sun before anyone comes.

retention_analysis:
Keep the packed earth road with its cart ruts, the mud-brick wall, the stone milestone, the lime-washed houses with grey tiled roofs, the old locust tree and the low dry daylight.

detailed_description:
Slow push-in, full shot, 35mm lens at f/2.8, the camera at standing eye height on the road looking along it into the village: the packed earth road fills the lower half of the frame and runs away from the lens, the low mud-brick wall and the stone milestone stand at the left, the lime-washed houses with grey tiled roofs line the road, and the old bare locust tree fills the right side with its branches running out of the top of the frame. Dry fields and bare hills close the far end of the road. Low morning sun comes from the left, throws long soft shadows of the wall and the tree across the ground, and fine dust drifts through the light. Nobody is on the road — no people, no animals, nothing moving but the dust. Photorealistic live-action film look, digital cinema sensor, fine grain, natural daylight.

overall_soundscape:
A thin breeze through the locust branches; dry grass rustling at the roadside; two distant birds; the empty morning air of the village with almost no room tone.

non_diegetic_music:
A single low bowed string note enters and holds under the whole shot without resolving.
[SHOT_END]
